bugs.title: No "Disconnect successful" confirmation next to the button
bugs.root_cause: ConnectionDisconnect navigated straight to the page; only the LinkedIn section had an anchor id.
bugs.fix_summary: Show a success notice for ~1.8 s, then reload onto the network's own section; added anchors for the other six networks.

bugs.title: Disconnect button failed with HTTP 404 (then 500) on every network
bugs.root_cause: API Gateway had no POST /connections/disconnect route; once added, the dev-api Lambda resource policy had no per-route invoke permission for it.
bugs.fix_summary: Created route aqvtww7 -> integration h25cb92, then Dean added Lambda permission statement disconnect-route. Keyless smoke test now returns 401.
